nodes.label: 圆门北侧院内
nodes.basis: 向主殿的开敞院落；入口位置仅为模型内安全观察起点。

nodes.label: 院落中段
nodes.basis: 正向主殿与反向圆门照片共同确认院落关系；并非原摄影点。

nodes.label: 院落望向主殿
nodes.basis: 在模型院地稍偏离中轴观察；偏移数值是展示估计，不声称实测行走线。

nodes.label: 主殿石阶前
nodes.basis: 主殿外观和阶前关系由3-01与3-11支持；停在已有模型最低石阶之外。

estimates.modelHeightStatus: Existing flat courtyard top inherited from the exterior model. Observed real-world minor terrace steps are not measured or reconstructed.
estimates.pathStatus: Bounded display route, not camera calibration or surveyed visitor access.

retainedLimitations: Independent transition to inside courtyard; no asserted outdoor-to-indoor threshold connection.
No ascent to the main hall, no access through closed doors or behind buildings.
No duplicated model, new halls, furnishings, garden elements or inferred connections.
Existing model omits real courtyard objects and small steps; collision clearance is for this GLB only.
Current source accuracy field 5m is imagery metadata, not surveyed route accuracy.
notice: 这是转入圆门内侧的局部院落观察，不表示已核实从门外连续穿门。复用正一观现有独立外观模型；正反向普通照片支持圆门、开敞院落与主殿石阶的关系。照片可见的院中低台阶尚未建模；这只是既有模型内的估计观察线，不能被当作真实无台阶通路。路线约43米，位置、偏移、1.65米视点及模型平整院地高度均为展示估计；真实台阶、高差、陈设位置未测量，不能用于现场导航。终点止于石阶前，殿内陈设、院中香炉和细部没有据此补建。
